programmes.d: Several people are murdered by a mysterious man in make-up at the beach.
Eddie takes in a runaway whose life is threatened by her mobster boyfriend.
Craig and Mitch must stop an out-of-control party boat before it crashes into the Santa Monica pier.
During a violent tropical storm, two escaped convicts shoot Garner and leave him to die.
Craig gets jealous when Mitch reunites with his and Craig’s old flame.
Eddie and Shauni rescue a child trapped in an armored car that’s about to fall into the ocean.
Mitch gets a surprise visit from his old mischievous Navy S.E.A.L. buddy and ex-Baywatch lifeguard.
Craig, Eddie and Cort are off to Mexico, but where Cort goes, trouble follows.
Cort and Eddie train junior lifeguards at a water park and make a dangerous discovery.
Eddie and Cort discover an abandoned ship with an illegal casino on board.
Eddie is unknowingly caught up in a 70-year-old legend after losing his rookie partner.
A local restaurateur puts up a $25,000 bounty for the largest shark caught during the Shark Derby.
Cort needs Mitch and Craig’s help in a water-skiing race to raise money for a nursing home.
Mitch has an accident while on a hang-gliding trip with Craig and Garner.
A massive earthquake leaves Gina's life hanging in the balance while Cort and Craig are trapped.
Mitch rescues an underwater photographer that claims to have been attacked in an underwater cave.
When a fishing trawler mysteriously sinks, the “Creature in the Bay” is thought responsible!
After Megan is attacked on the beach she struggles to regain her confidence.
Mitch rescues a man which leads a Hollywood producer to offer Mitch a starring role in a film.
Mitch receives an unexpected visit from his free-spirited brother whose son causes trouble.
After breaking up a gang fight on the beach Eddie has some gang members become lifeguards.
Eddie is attacked by a former mental patient known as “Hector the Collector.”
Eddie goes on a blind date with a morbidly overweight woman, which leads to complications.
Eddie is arrested for statutory rape after a teenage girl lies about seducing him in his tower.
Eddie is suspended from Baywatch over the false statutory rape charge.
Mitch falls for a beautiful woman who turns out to be a cold-blooded murderer and con artist.
Mitch and his ex-wife Gayle reconnect at their high school reunion with unforeseen results.
Eddie slips on sand and hits his head. When he regains consciousness, he is on Gilligan’s Island.
